description: Agglomérations d'assainissement - Haute-Loire - 2017 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. Sanitation agglomerations are areas defined by Article L 2224-10 of the General Code for Local and Regional Authorities (transposition of the European Directive of 21 May 1991). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Sanitation agglomerations — Haute-Loire — 2017" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include HAUTE-LOIRE, données ouvertes, open data, DDT 43. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
